transcriptionPolicy.firstWordSource: First nonempty whitespace-derived printed token, with only outer punctuation stripped; internal punctuation and genuine fused spelling preserved. Leading standalone dash is separate punctuation. See present,how and thepursuit decisions.
transcriptionPolicy.firstLexicalWordSource: Alternative conventional lexical word at the line start; keeps printed hyphenation fragments. It differs from literal printed-token form for present,how.
transcriptionPolicy.literalCharacters: Visible first-word letters and case preserved. Internal apostrophes/hyphens use the stated OCR transcription surface; raster glyphs do not establish original digital Unicode code points. Outer punctuation and leading standalone dashes are stripped only in first-word fields, not deleted from raw OCR/source.
transcriptionPolicy.fullText: Raw OCR is retained, unverified; page102 gutter blur prevents full-line exclusion.
transcriptionPolicy.ordering: Full-width introductory flow, then each independent column, then full-width closing flows; no row merging between columns.
transcriptionPolicy.labels: Standalone STOP is separate from regular text rows. Title/subtitle/headers/margins/footers remain paratext.
transcriptionPolicy.paragraphs: Visual source-reading classification, not author-controlled manuscript metadata.
